messages:
Nora Li: Heads-up: product wants a minimal EU rollout for model-v3-next. Goal: confirm regen quality, keep p95 <180ms, ensure cost delta <15%. Proposed plan below — want quick alignment on flags, gating, and fallbacks. @priya @diego @liam

Priya Nair: Proposed phasing: micro 0.5% (30m) -> small 2% (1h) -> regional ramp to 10% over 12h -> evaluate -> full. Add an A/B slice for 1% of traffic to run with a lightweight prompt rewrite to test latency-sensitive paths.

Diego Ramos: Telemetry/gates I care about: `rollout.latency.p95`, `rollout.errors.rate`, `rollout.eval.regression`, `rollout.cost.delta`. Hard gates: p95 >180ms OR errors >0.2% OR eval_regression_fail_rate >4% -> trigger soft rollback. Soft rollback = revert affected slices to v2. Hard rollback = flip `rollout:model-v3:eu:panic` -> global revert + paging. Use 5-min rolling windows and require two breaches within 10m to fire.

Liam O'Connor: Customer ops: add per-tenant opt-out and VIP tenant list (don't include VIPs in early ramps unless they opt-in). Also prep a short comms blurb for customers on the VIP list.

Priya Nair: Flag names and schema suggestion: `rollout:model-v3:eu:phase` with values `off, micro, small, ramp, on`; `rollout:model-v3:eu:ab_test_group` = `control|rewrite`; `rollout:model-v3:eu:panic` = boolean. We'll also expose `rollout:tenant_holdout:<tenant_id>` for opt-outs.

Nora Li: Good. Also add a cost-governor: if `rollout.cost.delta` >15% for 2 consecutive 10m windows, automatically throttle phase -> micro and notify finance and product.

Diego Ramos: Fallback routes: 1) divert to quantized variant (model-v3-q8) in-region, 2) if regional capacity >85% for 5m, spill canary to next region (eu-west -> eu-north) or to Dedicated pool for VIPs. We'll implement `traffic_shed_policy` with priorities: quantized -> spill-region -> dedicated.

Priya Nair: Runbook snippet for engineers:
```
# enable micro canary
feature_flags.set("rollout:model-v3:eu:phase", "micro")
feature_flags.set("rollout:model-v3:eu:ab_test_group", "rewrite")
# panic switch
feature_flags.set("rollout:model-v3:eu:panic", false)
```
Add automation to annotate PRs with the rollout ticket and experiment_id.

rollout-bot: Canary plan scheduled: `canary/model-v3-eu-mini` -> start 2024-06-10T08:00:00Z. Job: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/223344. Alerting channel: #product-rollouts.

Liam O'Connor: Preflight checklist (ops): 1) perf smoke at 2% replica with 95th percentile check, 2) run holdout eval set (tenants + public prompts), 3) validate per-tenant holdouts applied, 4) confirm alert escalation list. I'll own comms to customers on VIP list.

Priya Nair: Experiments: tag all canary traffic with `experiment=eu-mini-2024-06` and ensure logs contain `variant=control|v3`. We should also run a short A/B of prompt rewrite for latency-sensitive endpoints and compare p95 and regen quality.

Diego Ramos: Metric thresholds and actions (short):
- p95 >= 180ms -> mark incident risk, if occurs twice in 10m -> soft rollback
- errors >= 0.2% -> soft rollback immediately
- eval regression >= 4% -> soft rollback and block ramp
- cost delta >= 15% for 2x10m -> throttle to micro and notify finance

Nora Li: Owners & ETA: @Priya -> flags + experiment tagging (ETA 36h), @Diego -> gating automation + spill policies (ETA 48h), @Liam -> preflight + VIP comms (ETA 24h). Product will draft short FAQ and release notes.

Priya Nair: I'll open the rollout PR and attach runbook + experiment config. Will include a `/rollout status` command in CI that posts to the #product-rollouts channel.

Liam O'Connor: If anything triggers a hard rollback, use the phone tree and escalate to on-call SRE + product lead. I'll add contact numbers to the runbook.

Nora Li: Decision: greenlight to schedule micro canary next Monday pending infra deliverables. If blockers appear, flag by EOD Friday. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
